carmen (finance): FYI postmortem follow-up: short duplication window during a consumer leader swap led to ~2.0k invoices with token inflation. This thread: owners, timelines, and a proposed recurring audit to catch regressions.

yusuf (eng-ml): RCA summary: during a consumer group rebalance a small window allowed in-flight batches to be published twice because the publish path had an alternate retry branch active. Dedup relied on batch_key that wasn't collision-resistant across instance restarts. Repro script in gist.

leah (eng-sre): Containment: turned off alternate retry branch at 01:12 UTC and paused invoice finalization. No new anomalies since. Opened incident tickets and uploaded affected CSV.

billing-bot: Created BIL-7001: "invoice-token-reconcile" and BIL-7002: "invoice-freeze-hold". Linked to INC-91055. Affected CSV: s3://incidents/INC-91055/affected.csv

carmen (finance): Action owners (please ACK + ETA):
- @omar (platform): reconciliation pipeline + staging dry-run (48h)
- @yusuf (eng-ml): producer patch + regression tests (72h)
- @leah (eng-sre): rollout plan, runbook update, and invoice unfreeze checklist (24h)
- @tess (support): draft customer comms + impacted queue (EOD)
Finance will approve credits after reconciliation CSV review.

otar (typo) -- oops, carmen: edit: "omar" above.

omar (platform): Reconcile plan (brief): 1) identify invoices where event_count > 1 and abs(delta) > 60 in the event window; 2) replay events with strict dedupe logic; 3) produce audit CSV and ledger-hash diff for finance; 4) atomic patch to invoice rows once finance signs off. SQL I'll run in staging:

```sql
SELECT account_id, invoice_id, COUNT(*) AS ev_count, SUM(token_delta) AS sum_tokens, ABS(SUM(token_delta) - i.token_total) AS delta
FROM metering_events me JOIN invoices i USING (account_id, invoice_id)
WHERE me.ingested_at BETWEEN '2026-05-02 00:58:00' AND '2026-05-02 01:16:00'
GROUP BY account_id, invoice_id
HAVING ev_count > 1 AND delta > 60
LIMIT 3500;
```

omar (platform): I'll post the staging reconciliation diff before any prod change.

yusuf (eng-ml): I'll open the producer fix PR in ~4h. Fix: include producer_instance_uuid + epoch_window in batch key and add integration chaos test for rebalances. Also adding metric metering.publish_dup_rate and alert threshold 0.01% over 10m.

leah (eng-sre): Rollout ops: prefer 02:00-03:30 PT window, ff-first canary, validate no new dup metrics and consumer lag=0. Runbook will add a pre-roll drain step. I'll post runbook patch in 6h.

tess (support): ACK. Draft templates (brief + detailed) to #support-drafts by 16:30 PT. Will include opt-out/manual remediation flow.

billing-bot: Note: BIL-7002 will keep affected invoices from auto-finalizing until BIL-7001 sign-off.

carmen (finance): One additional ask: long-term detection — propose weekly ledger-hash audit job + alert on per-invoice deltas > X. If everyone agrees I'll make a ticket. Please ACK final ETAs.

omar (platform): ACK. Dry-run in 48h.

yusuf (eng-ml): ACK. PR in 4h.

leah (eng-sre): ACK. Runbook patch in 6h.

tess (support): ACK. Templates posted by EOD.

carmen (finance): Thanks all. I'll check progress here tomorrow 09:00 PT and schedule a retro after reconciliation completes. :white_check_mark:
